  JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId

  ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT g.Name AS genre, COUNT(il.InvoiceLineId) AS lines, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.Name
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT g.Name AS genre,
       SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue,
       SUM(t.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS cost_estimate,
       SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) - SUM(t.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS profit_estimate,
       CASE WHEN SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) - SUM(t.UnitPrice * il.Quantity)) / SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) END AS profit_margin_estimate
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.Name
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
assumptions: Used Track.UnitPrice as a cost proxy only to check for cost data; this is NOT a true cost.
